svg.title: A long span between the rails sags; a short one stays flat
svg.desc: Drawn to scale except for the sag, end-on views of a 1.6 mm panel resting on the oven's pin rails, which grip about 3 mm of each edge. Top, marked wrong: the panel is 200 mm across the rails and sags in the middle. Bottom, marked right: a panel 100 mm across sags one sixteenth as much. The sag is exaggerated by the same factor in both views.

g.text: ✗ 200 mm between the rails: sags in the middle
✓ 100 mm between the rails: stays flat
Grips about 3 mm of the edge
Parts shift; the panel can drop
Drawn to scale except the sag, which is exaggerated by the same factor in both views.
Sag grows with the fourth power of the span: twice the span, sixteen times the sag.
